title: Hook events: compaction and model switching
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: PreCompact, PostCompact, PreModelSwitch, PostModelSwitch.

hookEvent_PreCompact.title: PreCompact
hookEvent_PreCompact.description: Before context compaction. Exit code 2 or `decision: "block"` blocks it.

hookMatcherGroup_PreCompact.description: Matcher group for PreCompact: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on what triggered compaction. Values: `manual`, `auto`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_PreModelSwitch.title: PreModelSwitch
hookEvent_PreModelSwitch.description: Before Claude Code applies a model switch that the user or a client requested. Can block it. Default timeout 30 s; a timed-out hook blocks the switch.

hookMatcherGroup_PreModelSwitch.description: Matcher group for PreModelSwitch: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the canonical name of the model being switched to (e.g. `claude-opus-5`). Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).

hookEvent_PostModelSwitch.title: PostModelSwitch
hookEvent_PostModelSwitch.description: After the session's model changes, including automatic changes. Default timeout 30 s.

hookMatcherGroup_PostModelSwitch.description: Matcher group for PostModelSwitch: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies.
